[8:11PM] #Dopemu #TrafficUpdate 

Good flow from Cement to Dopemu bridge, Pako, and Adealu. 
Goye intersection to Moshalashi is also smooth. 
Dopemu Bridge to Akowonjo and Alaroro is moving well. 
There's some activity around Ogunlana to Egbeda due to commercial activities, but traffic is still moving. 
The return journey from Egbeda to Dopemu Bridge and Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway is smooth, thanks to officers managing the traffic.

#FollowLASTMA
